name: Cupertino
author: S M Ashikuzzaman Hriddho
description: macOS-style windows for Omarchy: traffic-light title bars, drag to move, edge resize, minimize to the bar, and half-screen snapping.

barWidget.description: Keeps the macOS-style title bars healthy. Hidden while they work; one-click fix when a Hyprland update stops them loading.

schema.label: Show even when title bars are healthy
